clue.text: King's ransom, untold gold — leaders on mission for this?

definitions.text: King's ransom, untold gold — leaders on mission for this?

clue.text: Recluse accepted backing sleuth inside, like this

clue.text: England's lay around middle of January? Wrong on both counts
